apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Call the REST API from scripts, CI and other services. Changes made with a key are recorded in the audit log under its name.
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet. Create one to toggle flags from a deploy pipeline or read experiments from a dashboard.
apiKeys.name: Name

roleHelp.admin: Admin keys can do anything a member can, except removing members.
roleHelp.readonly: Read-only keys can list and get, but cannot change anything.

apiKeys.createdWarning: Copy it now and store it somewhere safe. You won't be able to see it again.
apiKeys.revokeBody: Requests using this key fail immediately. This can't be undone; create a new key if you need access again.

rest.title: REST API
rest.description: Every operation is a POST to /api/v1/<area>/<operation> with a JSON body and your key as a bearer token.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Notify your services or a Slack channel when flags change, experiments start or stop, or SDK payloads update.
webhooks.empty: No webhooks yet. Add a Slack incoming webhook to tell your team when experiments start and stop.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.deleteBody: furca stops sending events to this URL. Past deliveries are not affected.
webhooks.secretWarning: Verify the furca-signature header (sha256=HMAC of the raw body) with this secret. It is shown only once.

formatHelp.json: Signed JSON body for your own services
formatHelp.slack: A one-line message for a Slack incoming webhook

form.name: Name
form.eventsHelp: Deliveries are sent once, with a 5 second timeout.
form.enabledHelp: Paused webhooks receive nothing until you turn them back on. Send test still works.

flag_updated.label: Flag changed
flag_updated.help: Created, edited, toggled, rules saved, archived or deleted

experiment_phase_started.label: New experiment phase
experiment_phase_started.help: Traffic changed and users were re-randomized
